```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggforce)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r Load extracted data with shapefiles, echo=FALSE}
data <- read.csv("cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets_shps.csv") %>% 
  select(studykey,eff_admin,new_location_period_id)
shps <- readRDS("cholera_climate_review/Data/shapefiles/location_shapefiles.rds")
data_shp <- data %>% 
  left_join(shps, by = c("new_location_period_id" = "lctn_pr")) %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf() 

```

```{r shapefiles, echo=FALSE,fig.height= 15,fig.width=15}
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = data_shp ,color = "black", fill = "lightblue", size = 0.1) +  # Add geometry with default fill
  theme_minimal() +                                          # Clean theme for better visuals
  labs(
    title = "Spatial distribution across all spatial scales"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),    # Style facet labels
    axis.text = element_blank(),                           # Remove axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank()                           # Remove axis ticks
  )
```

```{r admin1 shapefiles, echo=FALSE,fig.height= 15,fig.width=15}
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = data_shp %>% filter(eff_admin == "adm1"),color = "black", fill = "lightblue", size = 0.1) +  # Add geometry with default fill
  facet_wrap(~ new_location_period_id , ncol = 3) +                              # Facet by admin levels
  theme_minimal() +                                          # Clean theme for better visuals
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Distribution of admin1 units"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),    # Style facet labels
    axis.text = element_blank(),                           # Remove axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank()                           # Remove axis ticks
  )
```

```{r zoomed in admin1 shapefiles, echo=FALSE,fig.height= 8,fig.width=8}
# Get unique facet IDs
facet_ids <- unique(data_shp[data_shp$eff_admin=="adm1",]$new_location_period_id)

# Loop through each facet and create a plot
plots <- lapply(facet_ids, function(facet_id) {
  # Filter data for the current facet
  subset_data <- data_shp %>%
    filter(eff_admin == "adm1", new_location_period_id == facet_id)
  
  # Calculate bounding box
  bbox <- st_bbox(subset_data)
  
  # Create the plot for this facet
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = subset_data, color = "black", fill = "lightblue", size = 0.1) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
      ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = facet_id
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank()
    )
})

# Print all plots
# Assuming 'plots' is a list of ggplot objects
# Arrange the plots in a 4-column layout
arranged_plots <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 6)

# Display the arranged plots
print(arranged_plots)

```

```{r number of papers by spatial distributions, echo=FALSE,fig.height= 15,fig.width=15}
# Aggregate data to count the number of unique studykey values per geometry and admin level
data_aggregated <- data_shp %>%
  group_by(eff_admin, geometry) %>%
  summarize(paper_count = n_distinct(studykey)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(data = data_aggregated) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = paper_count), color = "black", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    name = "Number of Papers",
    trans = "log",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  facet_wrap_paginate(~ eff_admin, ncol = 2, nrow = 3, page = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Papers per Geometry by Administrative Levels (Paginated)",
    subtitle = "Zoomed into each admin level"
  )
```

```{r zoomed in number of papers by spatial distributions, echo=FALSE,fig.height= 15,fig.width=15}
# Create a list of plots for each admin level with dynamic bounding boxes
plots <- data_aggregated %>%
  group_split(eff_admin) %>%
  lapply(function(subset) {
    bbox <- st_bbox(subset)
    ggplot(data = subset) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = paper_count), color = "black", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "C",
        name = "Number of Papers",
        trans = "log",
        direction = -1
      ) +
      coord_sf(
        xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]),
        ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]),
        expand = FALSE
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Number of Papers -", subset$eff_admin[1]),
        subtitle = "Zoomed view for this admin level",
        caption = "Source: Your Dataset"
      )
  })

# Display all plots
for (plot in plots) {
  print(plot)
}
```
